long_biography.plain_text:
Antonio Puig Guasch co-founded GCA Architects with Josep Juanpere in Barcelona in 1986. Four decades later, he still leads the international architecture and interior-design studio, now with offices in Barcelona and Madrid. Its work spans headquarters, hotels and residential developments, including the Torre Puig buildings and Hotel Arts.

Outside the studio, Puig competed in endurance racing. He drove a Venturi 400 GTR at the 24 Hours of Le Mans and finished seventeenth overall. Motorsport records also show subsequent GT competition with Venturi and Ferrari machinery, extending that technical interest beyond a single race in Spain.
